snippet.title: The Doll Shop - Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3851680/
Wishlist now.

The Doll Shop is a hand-drawn narrative game – part romance, part horror – set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a young dollmaker who reunites with his childhood friend in an eerie snowbound village. Will you dare confess your secret?
